verdict.rationale: Morph documents Dedicated Endpoints: you reserve model capacity by choosing a model and plan, Morph provisions and operates it, and you connect an OpenAI client to the endpoint's own URL. That covers deploying on dedicated capacity separate from the shared token-billed endpoints. Nothing in the evidence mentions autoscaling or explicit GPU-level traffic isolation guarantees, and there is no independent corroboration. missing for 10: autoscaling configuration, explicit GPU hardware selection and isolation guarantees, depth of docs on dedicated deployments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
